import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income')

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax2, color='skyblue')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')

# 3. Marital Status Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('pastel')[0:len(marital_counts)]
ax3.pie(marital_counts, labels=marital_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Total Spending by Product Category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
product_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
product_spending = df[product_cols].sum()
product_spending.index = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors_bar = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_spending))
product_spending.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=colors_bar)
ax4.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Product Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Spending')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Purchase Channel Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
channel_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = df[channel_cols].sum()
channel_totals.index = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
channel_totals.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'])
ax5.set_title('Purchases by Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Channel')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Purchases')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 6. Income vs Total Spending
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[product_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=50)
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Income')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6, label='Age')

# 7. Campaign Response Rates
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_response = df[campaign_cols].sum()
campaign_response.index = ['Camp1', 'Camp2', 'Camp3', 'Camp4', 'Camp5', 'Response']
campaign_response.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color='coral')
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Campaign')
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 8. Children at Home Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
children_counts = df['TotalChildren'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax8.bar(children_counts.index, children_counts.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='darkgreen')
ax8.set_title('Distribution of Children at Home', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Number of Children')
ax8.set_ylabel('Count')

# 9. Recency vs Web Visits
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Recency', y='NumWebVisitsMonth', hue='Response', 
                palette={0: 'gray', 1: 'red'}, alpha=0.6, ax=ax9)
ax9.set_title('Recency vs Web Visits (by Response)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Recency (days)')
ax9.set_ylabel('Web Visits per Month')
ax9.legend(title='Response', loc='upper right')

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
